name: Dwarka Gate (submerged)
description: Interdimensional basalt arches offshore. Drilling was halted after steam drills struck a geothermal Lingam bed and blue auroras rose from the arches.
notes: From the Age of Machinery chart, where it sits in 'Jambhudweep – NW coast'. Its position is that era's, before the Shattering; canon states no other.
